主要内容: Bloomberg Law published a new treatise titled 'Mergers and Acquisitions of Privately Held Companies: Analysis, Forms and Agreements' on July 16, 2018. The book covers key legal and business issues related to acquiring privately held companies. Authored by Richard D. Harroch, David A. Lipkin, and Richard V. Smith, it includes over 50 forms and agreements, signing and closing checklists, and document request checklists for due diligence. Topics include common seller mistakes, negotiation tactics, and letters of intent. Harroch noted the increasing number of technology company acquisitions backed by venture capital or private equity. Bloomberg Law provides legal professionals with actionable intelligence, practice tools, and market data. For more information, visit www.bna.com/bloomberglaw.
